Single new control point on the two existing speed-weight paths; no dominant-cause attribution and no parameter-range ineffectiveness claim can be derived from this batch.
Deadline misses are present throughout the historical rows; raw termination and controller policy stops remain distinct and are not conflated with acceptance.
arguments.hypothesis: On the frozen stack, adding a positive control/recipe/holding_tip_speed_weight (0.05) to the terminal-only source execution 50618bf23b31464ba4f84c55cd26d1ca (holding 0.0 / terminal 0.05) reduces sampled final-window holding maximum world-tip speed below the source 0.035567 m/s toward the 0.02 m/s criterion while retaining terminal reach (terminal_error_m <= 0.01) and holding position (holding_max_error_m <= 0.01), so that joint_reach_holding_passed becomes true. The previously untested joint-positive branch (tested_branches.joint_positive empty) is the direct object of the test.
arguments.rationale:
Source selection (separate from retained baseline and latest tested): completed terminal-only execution 50618bf23b31464ba4f84c55cd26d1ca (candidate batch-43a6daab7e3c1ce6-3) has holding_tip_speed_weight 0.0 / terminal_tip_speed_weight 0.05, holding_max_error_m 0.008275 pass, holding_max_speed_m_s 0.035567 fail, terminal_error_m 0.008187 pass, joint_reach_holding_passed false, valid_complete_execution true. It is neither the retained baseline cf997605885642759ee33920e2c9e2ef (holding_max_error_m 0.05814, holding_max_speed_m_s 1.5810, terminal_error_m 0.00764, joint false) nor the latest tested 44dbf3bc2964402e9f6af6a93c0f8d7d (terminal 0.1, holding_max_speed_m_s 0.04868, joint false).

Observation / hypothesis / proposed test are kept distinct. Observations: the six completed rows form zero-zero (cf997605), holding-only positives (087adee8 0.05, 22241105 0.1, 25e26708 0.3), and terminal-only positives (50618bf2 0.05, 44dbf3bc 0.1); holding-only weights retained-fail the holding-speed criterion and 0.1/0.3 lost terminal reach, while terminal-only 0.05 produced the smallest sampled holding speed (0.035567) still above 0.02. Hypothesis (proposed test): a small holding weight added on top of terminal 0.05 lowers sampled holding speed below 0.035567 while terminal reach is retained, giving joint acceptance. Proposed test: exactly one changed configuration, holding 0.05 / terminal 0.05 (terminal fixed at the source value), one backend attempt, target_changed_configurations 1.

Only the two existing speed-weight paths are varied; task, actuation (force_bounds), controller_implementation (controller.gvs_nmpc@7.0.0), initializer, timing (control_period_s 0.01, 35 control updates), solver, horizon and all undeclared structural fields (robot) are preserved, as are acceptance and other_numerical_settings. claims are scoped: the association of holding-only positive weights with retained-fail holding speed and degraded terminal reach holds for the tested points and does not identify a dominant cause or ineffectiveness across the parameter range; sampled coverage and the absent continuous-time guarantee bound generalization. No separate numerical diagnostic work is planned, and no physical improvement is claimed before execution.
stopping_conditions: Stop after the single changed configuration has a complete evaluation and profile (target_changed_configurations=1), or after the single backend attempt cap is reached.
Stop on unknown or material failure, or if delivery capacity is insufficient to complete the changed configuration.
If joint_reach_holding_passed is true, stop and report the configuration as a joint-acceptance candidate for adoption review.
If holding_max_speed_m_s does not fall below the source 0.035567 m/s, stop raising holding_tip_speed_weight and report the observed adverse or non-monotone step.
If terminal reach or holding position acceptance is lost (terminal_reach_passed false or holding_max_error_m > 0.01), stop and report as completed physical evidence.
weakening_observations: Within the six completed rows only, holding-only positive weights did not approach the 0.02 m/s criterion: 087adee8 (holding 0.05/terminal 0.0) holding_max_speed_m_s 1.175005, 22241105 (0.1/0.0) 1.363232 with terminal_reach_passed false, 25e26708 (0.3/0.0) 1.127628 with terminal_reach_passed false; this scopes to those tested points and is not evidence of ineffectiveness across the whole weight range.

The terminal-weight step did not behave monotonically: 44dbf3bc (terminal 0.1) raised holding_max_speed_m_s by +0.013112 versus the 50618bf2 source (0.035567 -> 0.048675), so a further holding-weight addition need not lower sampled holding speed.

All completed rows report deadline_misses equal to control_updates (35) and real_time_demonstrated false; coverage is sampled (holding = retained samples in final 0.05 s, terminal = last execution sample) with continuous_time_guarantee false, so any outcome bounds only this sampled protocol.
A passing holding_max_error_m does not certify holding-speed prediction, and zero force_bound_violation_n does not exclude legal near-bound but finite-safe inputs.
